label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 064 ]

blocks.text: If you want to keep your job, remember these things. You should not stop every hour for coffee. And you should not leave early too often. An important part of your job may be the way you work with other people. If you are difficult to work with, you may have trouble. Or you may have trouble if you do not make friends with the other people at your job.

readingSentences.english: If you want to keep your job, remember these things.
readingSentences.korean: 직장을 계속 다니고 싶다면 다음을 기억하라.

readingSentences.english: You should not stop every hour for coffee.
readingSentences.korean: 커피를 마시려고 매시간 일을 멈춰서는 안 된다.

readingSentences.english: And you should not leave early too often.
readingSentences.korean: 그리고 너무 자주 일찍 퇴근해서도 안 된다.

readingSentences.english: An important part of your job may be the way you work with other people.
readingSentences.korean: 일에서 중요한 부분은 다른 사람들과 함께 일하는 방식일 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: If you are difficult to work with, you may have trouble.
readingSentences.korean: 함께 일하기 어려운 사람이라면 곤란을 겪을 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: Or you may have trouble if you do not make friends with the other people at your job.
readingSentences.korean: 또는 직장에서 다른 사람들과 친해지지 않으면 곤란을 겪을 수 있다.
